43
RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Wednesday, August 10, 2011/Sravana 19, 1933 (Saka)
————
(Ministries : Commerce and Industry; Culture; Defence; Home Affairs;
Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation; Labour and Employment;
Textiles; Urban Development)
Total number of questions — 20
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Funds allocated under JNNURM in
Bihar
†*141. SHRI RAJNITI PRASAD: Will
the Minister of URBAN
DEVELOPMENT be pleased to state:
(a) the number of cities in Bihar where
projects under Jawaharlal Nehru Urban
Renewal Mission (JNNURM) are
proposed to be undertaken and the amount
allocated for these projects;
(b) the project-wise plans for
implementation of these projects and the
status of their progress;
(c) whether it is a fact that this ambitious
scheme of Government is getting entangled
in the net of redtapism as the process of
preparing the projects and approving them
is very complex; and
(d) if so, the measures proposed to be
taken to expedite the implementation of
the projects taken up under JNNURM?
Bringing Delhi Police under the
control of Delhi Government
†*142. SHRI PARVEZ HASHMI: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether any proposal is under
consideration with regard to bringing Delhi
Police under the control of Delhi
Government;
(b) if so, the view of the Ministry on
this proposal;
(c) whether it is a fact that every State
has its own police force which makes the
States responsible to maintain law and
order; and
(d) the details of the measures being
taken regarding the deteriorating condition
of law and order in Delhi?

44
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Allowing FDI in retail sector
*143. SHRIMATI GUNDU SUDHA-
RANI: Will the Minister of COMMERCE
AND INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) the proposal under consideration of
Government for allowing Foreign Direct
Investment (FDI) in retail sector;
(b) whether any assessment or study has
been conducted by Government about its
impact on the local small shopkeepers; and
(c) the basis of the Ministry’s
contention that allowing FDI in retail  sector
would generate more jobs and reduce food
inflation?
Equipping Indian Navy with 'Kawach'
*144. SHRI SANJAY RAUT: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government proposes to
equip Indian Navy with "Kawach" which
has target hitting range of 45 km;
(b) whether test fires for "Kawach"
have already taken place;
(c) if so, by when it is likely to be
inducted in Indian Navy; and
(d) the details thereof?
Pakistani nationals jailed for terrorist
activities
*145. SHRI Y . S. CHOWDARY: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the details of Pakistani nationals who
have been jailed for terrorist activities across
the country;
(b) the details of expenditure incurred
on their security or otherwise;
(c) the details of Pakistani nationals
awarded capital punishment; and
(d) the number of persons hanged/
awarded death penalty till date?
Police atrocities in States
†*146. SHRI KAPTAN SINGH
SOLANKI: Will the Minister of HOME
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the cases of
police atrocities are on a rise throughout
the country, including Delhi and UP, during
the last three years;
(b) if so, the State-wise details thereof;
(c) the details of complaints received
against police during the last three years,
State-wise; and
(d) the action taken by Government in
this regard, State-wise?
Revival of textile units in Tirupur,
Tamil Nadu
*147. SHRI T.M. SELVAGANA-
PATHI: Will the Minister of TEXTILES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had decided to set up a group to work for
revival of the affected textile units in
Tirupur in Tamil Nadu;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) whether it is also a fact that more
than 1,000 textile units in Tirupur have
been closed; and
(d) the steps taken by Government to
re-open these units?
Production of iodized salt in Gujarat
*148. SHRI PARIMAL NATHWANI:
Will the Minister of COMMERCE AND
INDUSTRY be pleased to state:
(a) whether Gujarat is the largest
producer of salt in the country;

45
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(b) if so, the logic behind the Salt
Commissioner's Office being located in
Jaipur;
(c) how much iodized salt is produced
in Gujarat vis-a-vis other States of India;
(d) the State-wise details of the
consumption percentage of iodized salt;
(e) how many States distribute the
iodized salt through PDS enabling its reach
to the poor people; and
(f) whether iodized salt distributed
through PDS has lower price compared to
the one sold in open market?
Housing facilities under IHSDP
*149. DR. RAM PRAKASH: Will the
Minister of HOUSING AND URBAN
POVERTY ALLEVIATION be pleased to
state:
(a) whether Government has achieved
the target for creation of housing and
infrastructural facilities under provisioning
of basic services to urban poor and
Integrated Housing and Slum Development
Programme (IHSDP) all over the country
and particularly in Haryana;
(b) if so, whether any assessment has
been made of this Programme; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Issue of nationwide MNIC based
on NPR
*150. SHRI KANJIBHAI PA TEL: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has decided to prepare the National
Population Register (NPR) of usual
residents and issue nationwide Multi-
Purpose National Identity Cards (MNIC)
based on NPR;
(b) whether it is also a fact that a process
of 'social vetting' by Gram Sabhas and Ward
Committees will be used for MNIC and
that no other document of proof will be
required for the process; and
(c) the steps taken by Government to
ensure that the process of issuing MNIC is
foolproof and the card is not misused as a
proof of Indian Citizenship?
Infiltration of Bangladeshi and
Pakistani citizens
†*151. SHRI PARSHOTTAM
KHODABHAI RUPALA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Ministry is aware that
lakhs of Bangladeshi and Pakistani citizens
are infiltrating and residing in our country
without any valid documents and are
involved in anti-national activities;
(b) if so, the concrete steps taken by
Government in this direction;
(c) whether State Police faces many
difficulties due to the long process involved
in deporting these infiltrators from the
country after completion of court
proceeding and sentence and also due to
non-cooperation of BSF;
(d) if so, the steps taken by Government
in this direction; and
(e) the time by when the fencing work
of Indo-Bangladesh border will be
completed?
CDA study on National Defence Food
Management System
*152. SHRI RAM KRIPAL YADA V:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that recently

46
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Controller of Defence Accounts (CDA)
(Internal Audit) of the Ministry of Defence
has conducted a study on National Defence
Food Management System; and
(b) if so, the details of its observations
and recommendations?
Employees working at Mumbai/
Ahmedabad offices of NTC
*153. SHRI PRA VEEN RASHTRA-
PAL: Will the Minister of TEXTILES be
pleased to state:
(a) the details regarding employees
working with National Textiles
Corporation’s (NTC) Mumbai and
Ahmedabad offices as on 1 January, 2011
in the regular, ad-hoc and casual cadres;
(b) whether the Ministry has given
benefit of new pay scales as per Sixth
Central Pay Commission to all the
employees; and
(c) if so, the comparative old and new
pay scales of all the cadres in NTC offices
as on 1 January, 2011?
Incentives to handloom industry
*154. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of TEXTILES be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government is considering
to encourage handloom industry in the
country by providing more incentives;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) by when a final decision in this
regard is likely to be taken; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Hiring of SPOs in States
*155. SHRI SHIV ANAND TIWARI:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) the names of the States where
Special Police Officers (SPOs) have been
hired due to shortage of manpower in the
Para-Military Forces under the Police Act
of 1861; and
(b) whether Government proposes to
stop  hiring of Special Police Officers and
recruit on a regular basis to complete the
shortage?
Providing helicopters to Orissa for
anti-naxal operations
*156. SHRI MANGALA KISAN: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
has assured the Government of Orissa to
provide two dedicated IAF MI-17
helicopters to supplement its anti-naxalite
efforts; and
(b) if so, the progress thereof and by
when the helicopters will be made available
to the State?
Caste based census
†*157. SHRI RAM VILAS PASWAN:
Will the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
had assured census on the basis of caste;
(b) whether it is also a fact that instead
of caste-based census of the entire
population, caste-based census only of
people living below the poverty line is
being done;
(c) whether Government will conduct

47
NEW DELHI; V . K. AGNIHOTRI,
The 4th August, 2011 Secretary-General.
Sravana 13, 1933 (Saka)
caste based census of people of all castes;
and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Decline in human trafficking
*158. SHRI NAND KUMAR SAI: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether human trafficking in the
country has registered a decline in the recent
past;
(b) if so, the details of cases of human
trafficking registered during 2009-10 and
2010-11;
(c) whether US has taken India off the
human trafficking watch list and upgraded
it to Tier-II country in the recent past;
(d) if so, the details in this regard; and
(e) the reaction of Government thereto?
Misuse of ammonium nitrate by
terrorists
*159. SHRI GOVINDRAO ADIK: Will
the Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be
pleased to state:
(a) whether security agencies have
found ammonium nitrate being  used by
several terror groups to carry out blasts at
various parts of the country; and
(b) if so, the steps taken or proposed to
be taken to regulate, manufacture, storage,
transport and sale of explosives,
particularly ammonium nitrate in the
country to avoid misuse of such substance
by terror groups?
Rise in cases of human trafficking
*160. DR. T.N. SEEMA: Will the
Minister of HOME AFFAIRS be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the cases of
human trafficking are showing staggering
rise and currently there are 3 million human
trafficking victims in India, and 1.2 million
of them are children;
(b) whether it is also a fact that according
to National Human Rights Commission
(NHRC) average age of those who fall
victims to human trafficking is between
9 to 13;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor; and
(d) the steps taken by Government in
this regard?

I N D E X
(Ministry-wise)
Commerce and Industry : 143, 148,
Culture :—
Defence : 144, 152,
Home Affairs : 142, 145, 146, 150, 151, 155, 156, 157,
158, 159, 160,
Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation : 149,
Labour and Employment :—
Textiles : 147, 153, 154,
Urban Development : 141.
48
GMGIPMRND—732RS—04-08-2011.
